topic: Foldable iPhone Ultra — everything we know so far (Aug 2026)
verified_facts: Inner (unfolded) display 7.76 inches, 2,713 x 1,920, 4:3 aspect ratio — per one leaker — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
Thickness ~4.5mm unfolded, 9-9.5mm folded; would be Apple's thinnest device — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
Crease depth under 0.15mm, crease angle under 2.5 degrees, described as 'nearly invisible' unfolded — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
Apple pursued eliminating the crease 'regardless of cost' (direct quote on MacRumors roundup) — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
Hinge built from liquid metal (amorphous alloy Apple has held consumer-electronics rights to since 2010) — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
No Face ID; Touch ID moves to the power button — no room for TrueDepth in the thin chassis — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
Rear cameras: dual 48MP (main + ultra wide), no telephoto — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/

Pricing spread: Ming-Chi Kuo $2,000-$2,500; Bloomberg's Mark Gurman similar; UBS $1,800-$2,000; Fubon Research $2,400; IDC $2,500 average with some models up to $3,000 — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
Expected announcement September 2026 alongside iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max; event reported for September 8-9, 2026 — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
Likely official name 'iPhone Ultra'; 'iPhone Fold' is a media placeholder Apple is unlikely to use (Samsung Galaxy Fold) — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
Dual batteries, one per side, 5,400-5,800 mAh — largest capacity in any iPhone — https://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-fold/
Dummy unit measured on camera by Unbox Therapy: 117mm tall, 84.27mm wide, 11.02mm thick closed (without camera bump) — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=khefl5hYouM
explicitly_NOT_claimed: The DUMMY IS NOT THE PRODUCT. khefl5hYouM shows a non-functional shape mockup from an unidentified Chinese supplier. Never state or imply it is a real iPhone Ultra, a prototype, or Apple-sanctioned. Dummy beats carry a DUMMY UNIT label and the Unbox Therapy credit.

REAL iPhONES APPEAR IN THIS FOOTAGE AND MUST NEVER BE CAPTIONED AS THE FOLDABLE. Telling them apart: the dummy's camera bump has BLANK rings (no glass); a real iPhone has black glass lenses and an Apple logo. Clips cut and then DELETED for this reason: back-cameras (t216.5-218.0) and bump-macro (t222.6-225.0) are a real iPhone's camera, not the dummy's. Only clip-fold-back shows the dummy's own back.

The vertical seam on the dummy's printed face (t232-241) is a MOCKUP ARTEFACT, not the real device's crease. BANNED: pairing those frames with the 0.15mm crease claim or any line about how the crease looks.

The dummy's caliper readouts (46.0, 5.77 @t410-419) measure THE MOCKUP. BANNED as specifications. The footage runs as texture only; the sole thickness figure on screen is the sourced 4.5mm, footnoted.
BANNED SOURCE — youtube i2kck04-21A (AppleTrack) in its entirety: predominantly CGI concept renders plus a baked-in circular webcam PiP. Downloaded during scouting, used nowhere.
Apple has announced nothing: no name, no price, no date, no spec. Every figure is reported/leaked and carries on-screen attribution.
24MP under-display selfie camera — single-sourced and contradicted elsewhere. NOT claimed.
Two foldable sizes (7.9in / 8.3in, Jeff Pu) — uncorroborated. NOT claimed.
Colours, MagSafe and the Action Button — conflicting dummy data. NOT claimed.
October availability, staggered rollout, 10M unit target, A20/2nm, 12GB RAM, dual 5,400-5,800mAh batteries — real reports, cut for time. NOT claimed in this reel.
